notes.notes:
The following features have been implemented:

- Fixed an issue that the numbers of times you cleared weren't saved.
- Fixed an issue that your best global scores weren't saved.
- Fixed an issue that you were had wait for 6000 sec before the connection error occured when you cleared the game.
